reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    cols = set(); diag1 = set(); diag2 = set()
    ans = 0
    def bt(r):
        nonlocal ans
        if r == n: ans += 1; return
        for c in range(n):
            if c in cols or (r - c) in diag1 or (r + c) in diag2: continue
            cols.add(c); diag1.add(r - c); diag2.add(r + c)
            bt(r + 1)
            cols.remove(c); diag1.remove(r - c); diag2.remove(r + c)
    bt(0)
    print(ans)
